articles.title: These Stocks Are Today’s Movers: JPMorgan, Delta, L3Harris, Intel, AMD, BNY Mellon, and More
articles.mainIdea: These Stocks Are Today’s Movers: JPMorgan, Delta, L3Harris, Intel, AMD, BNY Mellon, and More
articles.summary: Barrons.com: These Stocks Are Today’s Movers: JPMorgan, Delta, L3Harris, Intel, AMD, BNY Mellon, and More. Stock futures were falling Tuesday as investors digested quarterly results from JPMorgan Chase and Delta Air Lines both of which kicked off the earnings season. JPMorgan Chase rose 0.4%. Although the bank’s profit declined 7% in the fourth quarter, revenue rose on the back of higher fees and interest income. Related tickers mentioned: AMD, DAL, GOOG, INTC, JPM.
